title: Checkout & Payment Gateway 5xx Latency Spike Runbook
content: When checkout-payment-service experiences HTTP 503 errors > 5% and p99 latency > 1500ms following a canary release (e.g., v2.14.0-canary), Cloud SQL connection pool exhaustion is the primary root cause. Immediately open a critical P0/P1 incident and execute a production service rollback to revision v2.13.4-stable after obtaining Human-in-the-Loop approval.
remediation_steps: Verify service error rate and p99 latency via query_production_telemetry_metrics.
Create an incident ticket via create_critical_incident_ticket.
Obtain Human-in-the-Loop confirmation and execute execute_production_service_rollback to v2.13.4-stable.

title: Identity & Auth Token Service Redis Memory Eviction Runbook
content: Elevated 401/500 errors on identity-auth-service accompanied by Redis cache hit ratio dropping below 65% indicate session TTL misconfiguration. Roll back the offending config revision or flush stale anonymous session keys.
remediation_steps: Consult Redis TTL policy and record preventative action via record_postmortem_action_item.

title: Vertex AI & GKE GPU Autoscaler Cost Anomaly Playbook
content: If daily cloud spend on ml-inference-cluster exceeds the FinOps baseline budget by >40%, inspect unattached A100/H100 GPU replica node pools and runaway batch evaluation jobs. Scale down idle GPU nodes and enforce max-replica autoscaler quotas.
remediation_steps: Scale down idle GPU node pools and log governance tracking via record_postmortem_action_item.
